title: Almost a Hundred: 99 + 36
objective: Apply the round-up-then-correct-total structure to a bigger benchmark jump (99 to 100), showing the strategy scales.
studentQuestion: 99 is almost 100 — how does that help us here?

teaching.break: 99 + 1 = 100 — treat the problem as if it were 100 + 36, remembering 1 extra was added.
teaching.transform: 99 + 36 and 100 + 36 - 1 — same total (135), reached via the friendlier hundred.

mastery.evidence: Correctly executes the full round-up-and-correct structure, including the final subtraction, for 2 examples.
